questions.question: Which specimen or diagnostic finding belongs in a reference record for Dibothriocephalus latus?
options: Microfilariae in a peripheral blood film.
Operculated eggs and proglottids in stool.
Malaria rings inside erythrocytes in a thin blood film.
Asymmetrical pinworm eggs on a perianal adhesive-tape specimen.
questions.explanation: Operculated eggs and proglottids in stool. Wet mounts at 100–400×; molecular testing can resolve related fish tapeworm species.
